channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Barack Obama | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Barack Obama from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Barack Obama
item.description:
Stephen Curry on Barack Obama’s message to USA Basketball during Tuesday speech:

“He wants us to win. That’s what the U.S. has been known for.”

Stephen Curry on Barack Obama, Jul 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Josh Hart on Barack Obama
item.description:
Josh Hart:

“I definitely wish I got to 50. I don't know when I'm gonna have another night like this. ButI'm blessed. I'm happy with 44. I got the Barack Obama.”

Josh Hart on Barack Obama, Mar 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Ryan Smith on Barack Obama
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Ryan Smith on how he's seen the Miller's as owners.

“I always used this quote from Barack Obama, when people would go low they would go high. They've gone high on every single thing that they've ever done.”

Ryan Smith on Barack Obama, Dec 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Barack Obama
item.description:
Mark Medina:Anthony Davis on President Obama telling LeBron James to have AD do all the work to open the season:

“I am younger than LeBron, so President Obama would say something like that.”

Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Barack Obama, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: LeBron James on Barack Obama
item.description:
Lakers’ LeBron James:

“President Obama is a great man and I wish he was still president of the United States.”

LeBron James on Barack Obama, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Jason Kidd, Barack Obama
item.description:
Mavericks’ Luka Doncic on his visit with President Barack Obama:

“He said I did a fantastic job, which inspired me, and he said, ‘Don’t shoot like [Jason] Kidd.’”

Luka Doncic on Jason Kidd, Barack Obama, Feb 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Barack Obama
item.description:
Pelicans’Zion Williamson on meeting President Barack Obama:

“It felt great. It was even crazier when he started talking about my @DukeMBB games. He was even talking about my recent games. I was like, ‘You’re keeping up with me? I’m 19.’”

Zion Williamson on Barack Obama, Feb 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Barack Obama
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on whether his Vote For Our Lives shirt has anything to do with Barack Obama being here tonight:

“Actually, I wasn't aware that he was coming until a little while ago. The shirt has everything to do with the tragedy in Virginia Beach a couple of days ago.”

Steve Kerr on Barack Obama, Jun 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Barack Obama, Michelle Obama
item.description:
They were inspired by Michelle Obama's IVF story in her memoir, Becoming.

“What Michelle and Barack did was like another strong, powerful voice in the African-American community stepping up, educating, and having a responsibility in saying, 'You're not the only one,'”

Dwyane Wade on Barack Obama, Michelle Obama, Dec 9, 2018. Source: Oprah Mag.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Barack Obama
item.description:
Bucks coachMike Budenholzer on Barack Obama’s assessment of Giannis (

“He is ballin’): “I always agree with Barack Obama. If he said it, I’m with him.”

Mike Budenholzer on Barack Obama, Oct 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Barack Obama
item.description:
that former President Barack Obama has invited him to play golf, but he doesn't have the time to make it out to the East coast to play.

“Barack, if you're listening, I appreciate the invite. It's not that I don't want to be there, it's that I literally just can't,”

Stephen Curry on Barack Obama, Aug 17, 2018. Source: businessinsider.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Barack Obama
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Steph Curry:

“The stuff that I've turned down, and that includes our former President that has invited me to play golfbut I cannot get to the East Coast in the next week to play with him. So Barack, if you're listening, I appreciate the invite.”

Stephen Curry on Barack Obama, Aug 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Barack Obama
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on Barack Obama saying he'd pick SA if he were a free agent:

“That's very flattering. I'd have to do a background check on him, though, bc I've heard some things he's done in the past aren't very good. I can't remember where I heard that stuff, but I'd have to do a background check”

Gregg Popovich on Barack Obama, Feb 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Barack Obama
item.description:
Tim Cato:Carlisle on Steph's non-suspension:

“Steph played golf with Jordan Spieth and President Obama, so I just figured he worked out a pardon.”

Rick Carlisle on Barack Obama, Oct 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Barack Obama
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Curry:

“I've played golf with Obama. I'm pretty sure I won't get a tee time invite during this regime.”

Stephen Curry on Barack Obama, Sep 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Timofey Mozgov on Barack Obama, Donald Trump
item.description:
Timofey Mozgov:

“Some of the things he does, you've got to understand, like Trump, like Obama, like American presidents [try to make] America better, this is the same way. It's like any country -- Putin or whoever. It's for everybody -- whatever decision you make, you probably think how it will be better for your people. If I was president, I would be the best to my people.”

Timofey Mozgov on Barack Obama, Donald Trump, Feb 7, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: David Blatt on Barack Obama
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Blatt on playing front of president Obama:

“I’ve been in front of some presidents in other parts of the world, actually.”

David Blatt on Barack Obama, Oct 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Draymond Green on Barack Obama
item.description:
Draymond Green on President Obama:

“He's like, 'My guy! My favorite player.' That was pretty dope to me.”

Draymond Green on Barack Obama, Oct 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama
item.description:
“Why it’s been left to me to smooth things over, I don’t know. Dennis Rodman, of all people. Keeping us safe is really not my job; it’s the black guy’s [Obama's] job. But I’ll tell you this: If I don’t finish in the top three for the next Nobel Peace Prize, something’s seriously wrong.”

Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama, Jul 2, 2013. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama
item.description:
Rodman had angry words for Obama.

“We got a black president (who) can't even go talk to (Kim),”

Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama, May 12, 2013. Source: newsmax.com.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama
item.description:
“He asked me to give Obama something to say and do one thing. He wants Obama to do one thing, call him,”

Dennis Rodman on Barack Obama, Mar 4, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Barack Obama
item.description:
But when prodded, he let everyone know where his hopes rested.

“Ifyou want to have a political conversation, let's sit over there and I'll tell you why I think President Obama is the right man,”

Lawrence Frank on Barack Obama, Nov 7, 2012. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Ray Allen on Barack Obama
item.description:
“But the one thing that Mike never was is political. I think in today's era, the NBA player has an even greater podium if he chooses to use it. And with Barack Obama being the first black President, it's a great forum. I think that would separate him from anybody who's done this.”

Ray Allen on Barack Obama, Nov 7, 2012. Source: CBSSports.com.
